run_pybullet_direct_rendering: run a pybullet DIRECT mode simulation that renders camera images with OpenGL and displays them via matplotlib
create_urdf_scene: create a pybullet simulation scene by loading URDF files for a plane and r2d2 robot model
build_camera_view_matrix: build a camera view matrix using computeViewMatrixFromYawPitchRoll with yaw, pitch, roll, and distance parameters
render_camera_image_with_depth: render a camera image using getCameraImage to capture RGB color data and depth buffer from the simulation
compute_projection_matrix: compute a camera projection matrix using computeProjectionMatrixFOV with field of view, aspect ratio, and near/far planes
